scripts.dev: pnpm infra:up && pnpm migrate && pnpm dev:services
scripts.test:integration:setup: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yaml exec -T postgres sh -c 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname = '"'"'imageflow_test'"'"'" | grep -q 1 || createdb -U "$POSTGRES_USER" imageflow_test'
scripts.test:integration: pnpm infra:up && pnpm test:integration:setup && IMAGEFLOW_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://imageflow:imageflow_dev@localhost:5432/imageflow_test?sslmode=disable IMAGEFLOW_TEST_NATS_URL=nats://localhost:4222 pnpm --filter @imageflow/backend test:integration
